column4: Ordinary enemy health now follows locked custom settings once, including saved and later-spawned enemies.
Custom spawn frequency changes ordinary initial density and respawn intervals while preserving existing rewards.
Custom generation stops searching when the requested enemy density exceeds available legal spawn cells.
Hunger depletion and negative hunger costs follow the selected rate without changing food restoration.
Player and enemy defense settings scale the existing complete defensive roll once without changing shields or immunities.
The Chalice damage preview now matches custom defense settings without consuming random numbers.
Added health persistence, hunger, combined generation, crowded-floor and defensive-roll regression tests.
Recorded TEST116's successful checks and this candidate's tested scope, failures and remaining alpha work.
I added enemy health, spawn frequency, hunger and defense effects while preserving neutral behavior. Offensive attribution and the remaining sliders are still in development.
